_comment: The English (29 CFR 1926) training-utility arm: the US STaR rows of the v0.5.3-style build on Qwen3-8B under the Korean recipe, scored on the US key with the English judge panel. 791 rows give about 50 optimiser steps at two epochs, so a six-epoch arm matches the step count of the Korean 2,202-row arms. The base is rescored so that all three runs share one grader version. Run with run_experiment.sh experiments/exp_us.json.
